name: AlpacaEval 2.0
intro: AlpacaEval 2.0是一个自动化评估框架，利用基于GPT-4的成对比较生成模型胜率。引入长度控制胜率，减少模型偏好长回答的偏差，提高与人类偏好的相关性和评测鲁棒性。
build_method: 固定指令集、基线与候选回复生成、GPT-4-Turbo成对评审、长度控制GLM
task_type: 排序, 对话, 开放式问答
build_method_en: Fixed 805-instruction set, gpt-4-1106-preview and candidate responses, logprob-based continuous pairwise judging, length-controlled GLM
intro_en: AlpacaEval 2.0 is an automated evaluation framework that uses GPT-4-based pairwise comparisons to generate model win rates. It introduces length-controlled win rates to reduce bias toward longer responses, enhancing correlation with human preferences and evaluation robustness.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A[Reuse fixed 805 AlpacaEval instructions] --> B[gpt-4-1106-preview baseline + candidate responses]
    B --> C[Randomized weighted_alpaca_eval_gpt4_turbo single-token judging]
    C --> D[Logprobs produce continuous preference]
    D --> E[Weighted win rate]
    D --> F[Antisymmetric GLM: model identity + length difference + instruction difficulty]
    F --> G[Five-fold CV and L2 regularization]
    G --> H[Set length term to zero]
    H --> I[Length-controlled win rate]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2404.04475v2 §2, §3, and §4 plus tatsu-lab/alpaca_eval revision cd543a149df89434d8a54582c0151c0b945c3d20. AlpacaEval 2.0 reuses the fixed 805 instructions; compares gpt-4-1106-preview baseline and candidate responses in randomized order; uses weighted_alpaca_eval_gpt4_turbo single-token logprobs for continuous preference and weighted win rate; and fits an antisymmetric GLM using model identity, output-length difference, and instruction difficulty with five-fold cross-validation and L2 regularization. Setting the length term to zero yields LC win rate while retaining self-50% and swap symmetry; the paper reports lower verbosity gameability and higher Chatbot Arena correlation.
